mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.* FROM student s JOIN student_enrollment e ON e.student_id = s.id AND e.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND e.status = 'ENROLLED' JOIN school_academic_year y ON y.id = e.academic_year_id AND y.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND y.is_current = 1 WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (#{name} IS NULL OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')) AND (#{gender} IS NULL OR s.gender = #{gender}) AND (#{studentNo} IS NULL OR s.student_no = #{studentNo}) AND (#{schoolWide} = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_campus_admin ca WHERE ca.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND ca.campus_id = e.campus_id AND ca.user_id = #{userId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_homeroom_assignment ha WHERE ha.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND ha.class_id = e.class_id AND ha.user_id = #{userId} AND ha.ends_on IS NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_school_class_scope ts WHERE ts.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND ts.class_id = e.class_id AND ts.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY s.student_no LIMIT #{limit}
